mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (title, content, user_id, created_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{userId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.title, u.username, p.created_at FROM posts p JOIN member u ON p.user_id = u.id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content, u.username, p.created_at FROM posts p JOIN member u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
